messages:
alex: Heads-up — eu-west1 reporting degraded GPU capacity. ~30% of `gpu-pool-zeta` nodes showing OOM/restart churn, scheduler can't provision replacements (errors look like NVML timeouts). Incident-bot already created an S2.
incident-bot: Incident S2 #2347 opened for eu-west1: degraded-gpu-capacity. Pager sent to eng-oncall rotation. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-region-failover
priya: copying logs now. if autoscaler failing on NVML timeouts we should prevent noisy churn. can we disable rolling updates and mark affected AZ as drain?
taylor: agree — suggest traffic shift to eu-central in staged increments. I'll prepare route weights. @mira can you verify capacity there?
mira: eu-central has headroom (~45% free GPUs) but a few reserved clusters for Dedicated customers. I can reserve a 20% buffer and confirm by 2 mins.
alex: ok, plan: 1) mark problematic nodes cordoned: `kubectl cordon <node>` 2) pause nodepool autoscaler 3) shift 20% traffic to eu-central, monitor tail latency 4) if stable, shift another 30% 5) restore once nodes healthy. keep support/ops-sre in loop.
sam: can we do an immediate soft-failover via trafficctl? command: ```
# increase weight to eu-central by 20%
trafficctl set-weight --region eu-central --delta +20
``` 
sam: adding that to the incident timeline.
priya: small nit — current paging policy escalates to S1 after 15m. for region failover events we should tighten to 5m and notify infra-leads earlier. recommend a temporary tweak for this incident and a follow-up RFC.
incident-bot: Note: paging policy change request logged as task T-998. To apply change run: `opsctl update-pager --policy region-failover --escalation 5m` (requires infra-lead approval).
taylor: i'm on the go-forward button if @alex approves. alex? can you own handoff to next shift after we stabilize? you'll still be follow-on.
alex: yep I'll own the immediate triage and then hand to @mira for overnight watch. @taylor please execute the 20% shift now.
taylor: executing: `trafficctl set-weight --region eu-central --delta +20` — returning logs.
taylor: done. latency tail looks fine so far, error rate down 12% at ingress.
mira: confirmed buffer reserved. monitoring KV cache eviction metrics — no spike yet.
priya: adding temporary alert to pulse channel: `region-eu-west-degraded` with 3m eval window so we can catch regressions quickly.
sam: small ops note — cost hit will be slightly higher for burst to eu-central, tracked under billing tag `incident-2347`. we should include cost run in postmortem.
alex: agree. for on-call handoff: i'll post a short summary in #eng-oncall-handoffs 10 mins before my shift ends and @mira will accept. also creating a short TODO list in the incident ticket.
incident-bot: S2 #2347 updated: routing shift +20% applied; paging policy change requested; owners: alex -> mira (handoff pending). Timeline: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2347
mira: will take over in 45m if stable. otherwise i'll escalate earlier.
alex: thanks all. action items: priya collect NVML logs & disable rolling updates; taylor monitor latency & apply next +30% if stable; sam track cost; mira prep overnight watch. ping here before handoff. :thumbsup:
